name: The Back Room
address: 102 Norfolk St (between Delancey & Rivington), New York, NY 10002
status_note: Official site is current. It lists closures for private events on 10/21, 10/24 and 10/28–10/31, so check before Halloween week. Haute Living's July 2026 guide also lists it as operating.

dress.answer: No hats, flip-flops, men's tanks or real fur
dress.detail: The official site bans baseball hats, flip-flops, tank tops on men and real fur (faux fur, leather and suede are fine); Time Out repeats the same rules.

sources.name: The Back Room official reservations page

getting_in.value: Walk-ins welcome. Reserve through the venue site (taken until 11:30pm, Tue–Sun). Small-group reservations have a bar minimum, large groups need bottle service Fri–Sat, and bachelor/bachelorette parties aren't allowed. Enter through the 'Lower East Side Toy Company' gate.

sources.name: The Back Room official reservations page

price.value: Moderate (Time Out $$ of 4); exact cocktail prices aren't published, and some reviewers call the drinks small or pricey

accessibility.value: Entrance is down an alley passage and covered staircase; not described as step-free

subway.value: Delancey St / Essex St (F, J, M, Z), ~3 min walk

skip_if: You want inventive cocktails: Time Out calls them crowd-pleasing classics and the teacup service a gimmick
You're under 25 on a weekend: the Fri–Sat age floor is 25
